purpose: Coordinate real multi-worker contention canaries so the required number of distinct /wc workers are durably armed before any contender races the deterministic portfolio pin path.
authority_boundary: Barrier registration and RELEASE coordinate timing only. They grant no portfolio execution authority, do not replace PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1, and cannot imply Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority.

rules.barrier_config: A fixture declares required_contenders, opened_at and deadline_at before workers enter. Barrier config is immutable candidate evidence.
rules.registration: Each distinct /wc worker atomically CREATEs exactly one append-only entrant receipt keyed by worker_id. Re-registering the same worker is idempotent and MUST NOT increase quorum.
rules.release_predicate: RELEASE is eligible only when the number of distinct entrant worker_ids is >= required_contenders and observed_at is strictly before deadline_at. The emitted release cohort MUST be exactly the lexicographic first required_contenders distinct valid entrant worker_ids.
rules.release_race: Eligible contenders may race atomic CREATE on the single deterministic RELEASE.json path. Exactly one create wins; create-exists readers consume the same release evidence.
rules.release_authority: RELEASE grants no execution authority. After release, only worker_ids listed in the exact release cohort may race the deterministic PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1 generation path. Other entrants re-enter normal allocation. The pin winner may claim; released losers create no claim, persist collision receipts and re-enter allocation.
rules.timeout: If deadline_at is reached without RELEASE, an entrant creates an append-only timeout receipt, MUST NOT attempt the portfolio pin for that fixture, and re-enters allocation.
rules.late_release: A barrier that reaches deadline without RELEASE cannot release late merely because more entrants arrive afterward; use a fresh fixture/barrier generation instead.
rules.human_timing: No human synchronization, numbered worker routing or manual countdown is required.
rules.cohort_membership: RELEASE entrant_worker_ids has exactly required_contenders unique IDs in canonical lexicographic order. Overfull, unsorted or unknown-entrant RELEASE documents are invalid and cannot open the PIN gate.

tests: 2 distinct entrants -> one RELEASE creator -> one pin winner + one loser collision receipt
5 distinct entrants -> one RELEASE creator -> one pin winner + four loser collision receipts
duplicate registration by one worker does not inflate quorum
RELEASE itself creates no pin and grants no execution authority
deadline with insufficient quorum -> no RELEASE, no pin attempt, timeout receipt + REENTER_ALLOCATION
overfull/unsorted/unknown-entrant RELEASE is invalid; nonmembers re-enter normal allocation
non_promotion: Passing isolated tests is candidate evidence only. Integration into binding worker/portfolio protocols requires an independently authorized verification/integration step.

static_contract_revision.reason: Align candidate wording with binding exact-release-cohort and membership-gated PIN semantics already enforced by allocator routing and EFF014 regression.
